text:
dara-peopleops: Heads up everyone  we've updated Benefits Enrollment for 2026: the open enrollment window is moving to May 10-24, HSA employer match is increasing to $1,200/year, and dependent verification requires re-enrollment this cycle. Please review the handbook page and complete the confirmation form by May 24. https://handbook.redwood.com/benefits/2026-enrollment

mike-comp: Quick clarifying q: is the HSA match change retroactive for contributions made earlier in the year?

dara-peopleops: Good Q. Match increase is pro-rated for contributions after the effective date (2026-05-10). We will not retroactively top-up contributions made before the start of enrollment. Full breakdown and formula on the page.

sophie-manager: For managers  do we need to collect any paperwork for dependents or will HR validate? Some of my directs have new dependents this year.

dara-peopleops: Dependents must be re-verified via the benefits portal; HR will validate uploaded docs. We added a checklist and sample documents to the handbook page. For exceptions (e.g., international documentation differences) flag to people-ops and we'll route to Benefits/Legal.

lms-bot: Reminder scheduled  Benefits microtraining assigned: "2026 Enrollment & Dependent Verification" (8 min). Auto-assigned to all benefits-eligible staff. Course link: https://lms.redwood.com/courses/benefits-enroll-2026

mike-comp: Will managers see completion statuses and who still needs to re-verify dependents? Want to avoid chasing during busy weeks.

dara-peopleops: Yes, managers will receive a completion roster on May 18 and a final list on May 25. We'll also send automated reminders to employees who haven't completed verification at 7 and 3 days before the deadline.

sophie-manager: Perfect. Also need a short blurb I can paste into my team channel. Managers keep asking for exact wording.

dara-peopleops: Draft blurb: "Open Enrollment May 10-24: HSA match increases to $1,200/yr. All employees must re-verify dependents this cycle. Please review the Benefits page and complete verification and the short course by May 24. Questions? DM @dara-peopleops." Feel free to copy.

finance-bot: Finance note: contractor stipend for benefits verification is not available. Only payroll employees eligible for HSA match. Expense code for enrollment-related reimbursements: BEN-VERIF.

mike-comp: Thanks  also wondering about part-timers and PR for HSA eligibility thresholds?

dara-peopleops: Part-timers who meet benefits eligibility (0.6 FTE+ and 90 days continuous service) are eligible; match is prorated by FTE. We added a sample table with 0.6 and 0.8 examples.

li-devex: Can we get a one-paragraph announcement for #general and an addendum for managers with copy-paste one-liners? We'll post in the quickstart docs.

dara-peopleops: Yup  I'll post to #general tomorrow morning and attach the manager one-liners. Also scheduling a 20-min AMA session on May 12 at 11:00 PT for benefits questions. RSVP link on the handbook page.

sophie-manager: If someone misses the re-verification deadline due to approved leave, is there an extension process?

dara-peopleops: Yes, we added a documented exception flow: manager flags case to people-ops, people-ops verifies leave, extension granted up to 30 days post-return. Exceptions after that require Benefits review. Details on the page.

mike-comp: Last Q: will we have an audit log of who uploaded documents and when? Compliance wants that.

dara-peopleops: Yes, we capture upload timestamps and verifier notes in the benefits portal. Audit exports available to People Ops and Legal on request.

lms-bot: Manager roster export will be created and emailed to dara-peopleops at 09:05 PT tomorrow.
